SIMD unsigned 32-bit vector API with arithmetic, logic, conversion, and transpose operations.

# Purpose
This header defines the `vu_t` vector unsigned integer API for SSE and related x86 SIMD extensions. It provides constructors, memory load and store operations, lane extract and insert helpers, arithmetic and bitwise operations, comparisons, conditional selection, type conversion, reductions, gather access, and a 4x4 transpose helper for 32-bit unsigned integer vectors. Most operations use macros or `static inline` functions to map directly to SIMD intrinsics and to keep the lane layout and type rules consistent with the other vector APIs. The file also includes fallback implementations for operations such as rotate and unsigned conversion where the ISA does not provide a direct intrinsic.
